Thanking you, Yours faithfully, For Paradeep Phosphates Limited Sachin Patil Company Secretary Encl: As above Paradeep Phosphates Ltd Posts Q2 FY 27 Results: 02nd November, 2026, Bengaluru: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd (BSE: 543530, NSE: PARADEEP), one of India’s leading fertilizer companies announced its financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. In Q2 FY27, Revenue from operations increased by 7% YoY to ₹ 7,364 crore, EBITDA reduced by 38% YoY to ₹ 431 crore, PBT reduced 65% YoY to ₹ 164 crore and PAT stood at ₹ 122 crore, down 64% YoY. In H1 27, the Company has achieved a Turnover of Rs 13,488 Cr higher by 19%, EBIDTA of Rs 1173 Cr. Despite the global uncertainty, particularly sulphur pricing/ availability and impact of the Rabi notification is yet to be factored in, the company delivered the EBITDA/ton for H1 of INR 5866 vis a vis INR 5719 of H1 FY 26 . We have been able to achieve sales volume of 1 Mn in Q2 FY 27 and 2 Mn tons in H1 FY 27 despite subdued monsoon in the country. We continue to invest in expansion projects and our key expansion project of Phos Acid expansion (Phase 1) from 500,000 MTPA to 700,000 MTPA at Paradeep is on track. The public hearing for the environmental approval for the capex program at Paradeep has been completed and we are expecting to receive environmental approvals shortly The energy efficiency improvement project at Goa has been completed and the energy consumption has been optimized by 0.3 GCcal/MT of Urea. Looking ahead, we believe the global uncertainty will prevail and we will remain committed to deliver consistent performance through integrated supply chain and product mix optimization. About Paradeep Phosphates Limited Paradeep Phosphates Ltd (PPL) is one of India’s largest phosphatic fertilizer companies, with an annual capacity of 3.7 million MT across Paradeep (Odisha), Goa, and Mangalore. The company produces DAP, NPK grades (N-10, N-12, N-14, N-19, N-20, N-28), and Urea, and markets them under trusted brands Jai Kisaan Navratna and Jai Kisaan Mangala. PPL serves over 12 million farmers through 100,000+ retailers across 18 states in India, supported by strong backward integration, a robust logistics network, and ESG-driven growth. For further information, please contact: Investorrelations.ppl@adventz.com https://www.paradeepphosphates.com/
